strongest_angle: Investigate the findings by Investigatory Powers Commissioner Lord Leveson condemning MI5's use of false evidence and dishonest senior officers in the Agent X neo-Nazi spy case.

key_facts.fact: In October 2026, Investigatory Powers Commissioner Lord Leveson stated that MI5 lying to multiple courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy was as serious as anything he had ever dealt with.

An investigation by the Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office revealed that MI5 had lied to the courts and misled the oversight body over its handling of a violent neo-Nazi informer known as Agent X.
In September 2026, the UK security service MI5 officially accepted that it gave evidence based on lies to three courts and that senior MI5 officers were repeatedly dishonest.
An IPCO report found that one senior MI5 officer lied repeatedly while another misled his own colleagues and lied about what he was told during the neo-Nazi counter-terrorism case.

numbers.label: Number of courts given false evidence

quotes.text: Oversight depends on candour, said investigatory powers commissioner Lord Leveson. Failings of candour undermine the entire basis of oversight and accountability.
quotes.speaker: Lord Leveson
